summary.headline: Planetary Hours by Day and Night
summary.text: Planetary-hour tables for the third through sixth days and Saturday, followed by seven corresponding night cycles. The text explains how the revolving, ruling, and exalting planets govern the day and night lords, and begins distinguishing beneficent from maleficent stars by the hours they occupy.
